value.rationale: The pair dependence among Lah block records controls the difference between the variance of the total count and the sum of block variances; it was previously bounded only qualitatively in the focal paper. The explicit full covariance matrix, spectral modes, and four mutually compatible scales show how negative pair dependence persists at fixed block count but becomes of order 1/k, 1/n, or 1/n² in distinct natural regimes. This is a complete parameter classification with direct use in second-order analyses of record-count decompositions, not an arbitrarily chosen finite slice.
